source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of decision making (PDF 41).

blocks.text: Decision making se program sharait ke mutabiq mukhtalif kaam chun sakta hai, bilkul aise jaise hum rozmarra zindagi mein faisle karte hain (barish ho to chhatri lo). Python is ke liye kai conditional statements deti hai: if, if-else, short hand if-else, if-elif-else aur nested if. Neeche har ek ki tafseel hai.

blocks.prompt: if statement ki shart ko kis qism ki qeemat deni chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Boolean qeemat, True ya False, aam taur par comparison ya logical expression se.

items: Decision making: shart sach ya jhoot dekh kar program raasta chunta hai.
